description: Queues a new crawl of the project's current build. This consumes crawl quota and takes 10 to 40 minutes. Only call it when the user explicitly asks to re-run or re-test; pass confirm: true to acknowledge. Needs a key created with the "crawl" scope and write access to the project.

confirm.description: Must be true. Confirms the user asked for a new crawl.

name: start_crawl
title: Start a crawl
